close_reason: Implemented onExists collision detection (Reject/Replace/Rename enum); compareCaseInsensitively; find_sibling_by_name; Rename suffix loop up to 100; +2 tests; 19 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Fill the TODO at filenode.rs:128. Before each create_object call in handle_filenode_set and handle_filenode_copy, query for a sibling with the same name via find_sibling_by_name. Apply onExists policy (null/replace/rename). Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 §3.2.3.

**Algorithm:**
1. Parse compareCaseInsensitively: bool (default false) from args.
2. Parse onExists into enum OnExists { Reject, Replace, Rename }. Unknown string → invalidArguments.
3. Inside create loop, after extracting parentId and name from JSON:
   Call backend.find_sibling_by_name(&account_id, parent_id, name, compare_case_insensitively).
   On Ok(Some(existing_id)):
     - Reject: insert notCreated with {"type":"alreadyExists","existingId":"<id>"}; continue.
     - Replace: check get_descendant_ids for existing_id (for nodeHasChildren guard); call destroy_object for existing_id; push to destroyed_list; proceed with create.
     - Rename: loop appending numeric suffix until find_sibling_by_name returns None (max 100 attempts → serverFail); mutate name in JSON object; proceed with create.
4. Apply same logic in handle_filenode_copy copy loop.
5. Update MockBackend: add set_sibling(parent_id: Option<&str>, name: &str, existing_id: &str) helper.

**Acceptance criteria (each grounded in §3.2.3):**
- onExists:null + collision → notCreated with type=alreadyExists and existingId present.
- onExists:replace + collision → existing id in destroyed, new node in created.
- onExists:replace + collision with non-empty directory (onDestroyRemoveChildren=false) → nodeHasChildren.
- onExists:rename + collision → created response contains new non-colliding name.
- compareCaseInsensitively:true + "Foo" collides with "foo" sibling → triggers onExists path.
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server exits 0.
title: Implement onExists collision detection in FileNode/set and /copy
